result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on your business size, budget, and whether you need payroll tax filing, employee benefits, time tracking, or accounting integration.

**If I were choosing payroll software for a small business in Canada, I'd start by comparing Wagepoint, QuickBooks Payroll, PaymentEvolution, and ADP.**

One important distinction: Canadian payroll software needs to handle CRA payroll deductions, CPP, EI, T4 slips, Records of Employment (ROEs), and applicable provincial requirements.

## Best payroll software in Canada

![Canada bank holidays and processing deadlines – Wagepoint](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BeLrJTSa5EcYGruwCn3ZDIxMUlfcXvUOAWq-VkLCLOXdz1jzkCEyci0fWXdrXgftGn6W2rYz-lwC8Y0IoRwsfjD4UWeNALSFIPbehrCIgAbl20XbCFLJPYeU7ALSuo1T_gE3VKm0vx7ep4xL3fMx4B0KmoO2Sjhoyl0a8jBEmmu8q-IbjKKE4gQp0SBNRaHp?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Wagepoint**

(Best overall for small businesses)

Starting around \$20 CAD/month + employee fees

- Designed specifically for Canadian payroll.
- CPP, EI and income tax calculations.
- CRA remittances, T4s and ROEs.
- Direct deposit and employee self-service.

Best if you want straightforward payroll without a complicated HR system.

[Visit Wagepoint](https://wagepoint.com/)

---

![Is QuickBooks Payroll Right For Your Small Business?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NxI61jHfD25H_nt8kRcYvHyRVuiwRzu6bQoayYIiX-p8_Tdm33tn9Kts01QntZfj3zQN9yJXydB71M2ZINU7Ryd1ra3_ou6nxuFmt_RR05RvmT9fmlWNmhedpXNBD2J0wX0aBNjOVffTjzvTAmAF2cn-1xTxGvSaxPrmNctmVLRRLezMTFbi5A9igGYQVZtF?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

Plans starting around \$30 CAD/month plus employee fees

- Payroll and bookkeeping together.
- Automatic payroll calculations.
- CRA tax forms and remittance features.
- Good accounting reports.

Best if you already use QuickBooks Online.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/payroll/)

---

![Companies that use Payment Evolution (50) | TheirStack.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1cP9EicgNlwshkHAa3yakjxAZedDOaxwrvf1O1FFeH_7PxED_g1qGv-UMbfg8ZpGyqlNKimYcaf8pVwlJ_INfKMsLfoBclfyQjFmKMUWaLX-M3AxAWCOYCvB6pRLX9_1R5rLP8YQoIa9k88ISej2CLxhXQv9Hy3-ue6UtEFIUxuPi1L-ykkUPnLAtqSEy-Fv?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PaymentEvolution**

(Best for budget-conscious businesses)

Free entry-level option; paid plans vary

- Canadian payroll processing.
- Direct deposit.
- Tax calculations and reporting.
- Pay-per-run pricing options.

Best for very small businesses or businesses with occasional payroll.

[Visit PaymentEvolution](https://www.paymentevolution.com/)

---

![ADP Mobile Solutions - Business App | MWM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/FjKuwKbE7H1O6PUG8RQHLvOdYy_cnuXPh0rTZTs9jh-eTU9cjwM9XYd1_itM1qM3OvSkzConWpFFKB_oWcDw0HcXG-1--TREcRlRH89LXc2kgQpy2kL5rDAWhgCSDib-aIkMzKLpxrV9ouQuQechTBo89K3TRmmC3mEebUgPjT_j5WfAjbjS-NpgXe2nfbgF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. ADP Canada**

(Best for growing businesses)

Custom pricing

- More advanced payroll management.
- HR and employee management.
- Multi-location and multi-province capabilities.
- More extensive support options.

Best if you expect to grow or have more complicated payroll requirements.

[Visit ADP Canada](https://www.adp.ca/)

---

![Payworks - Made In Canada Directory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JDMxoSeGQxMxiFL1WlmiX5yAKI9xRuaDUfQb6s6QcfAxTFJFbnN2kRi-gEYbnnOG4PrWAZTFpn3xs21LhDWxnQbK2WD_IFUqHaSdFe_RAXAGW3S0REiMzKGkkZ8KZy6JjkEu468uzREKIBJ8oxcvN3ufTsXg2JM7b6x4a2BhfAvpRoWj75NBPNUO2vBVAHLK?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Payworks**

(Best for hands-on support)

Custom pricing

- Canadian payroll and tax compliance.
- Time and attendance options.
- HR management.
- Payroll support and reporting.

Best if you prefer more assistance managing payroll.

[Visit Payworks](https://www.payworks.ca/)

## My recommendation

For a typical small business in Alberta, I'd narrow it down to Wagepoint and QuickBooks Payroll.

- Choose Wagepoint if payroll is your main priority.
- Choose QuickBooks if you want payroll and bookkeeping working together.
- Choose PaymentEvolution if keeping costs as low as possible is your priority.

## Let me narrow it down for your business

I have four questions that will help me recommend the best option rather than just the most popular one.

**1\. How many employees do you have?**

**2\. How often do you run payroll?**

---

**3\. What accounting software do you use?**

QuickBooks

Xero

Wave

Excel or spreadsheets

---

**4\. What's most important to you?**

Lowest possible cost

Easy to use and automated

Automatic CRA deductions and remittances

Payroll plus HR and employee management

Minimal work and hands-on support

I'll use those answers to narrow it down to the best two or three options and compare what they would actually cost your business.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
